description: This file defines a PHP class called LeaveRequestModel within the OrangeHRM leave plugin API module. The class models a leave request data structure for API responses, including properties like leave type and date applied. It utilizes traits and implements an interface to handle serialization and normalization of leave request entities.

classes.name: LeaveRequestModel
classes.description: A model class representing leave request data for API serialization, constructed from a LeaveRequest entity, with defined filters and attribute mappings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the model with a LeaveRequest entity and sets filters and attribute names for serialization.
